# coolify_application_preview (Resource)

Tracks the lifecycle of a PR preview deployment so it gets cleaned up when the resource is destroyed. Coolify has **no create or read API for previews** — it creates them automatically from GitHub App pull-request webhook events, never via a direct API call — so `create` is state-only (nothing is called), and `destroy` is the only real API interaction (`DELETE /applications/{uuid}/previews/{pull_request_id}`). Use this to guarantee a preview environment doesn't outlive the `terraform destroy` of whatever created it, rather than to provision the preview itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Coolify creates the preview itself from a GitHub App pull-request webhook
# — this resource does not provision it, only guarantees it's torn down
# when destroyed (e.g. as part of a CI job that closes out a PR's stack).
resource "coolify_application_preview" "pr" {
  application_uuid = coolify_application.web.uuid
  pull_request_id  = 42
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_uuid` (String) UUID of the application that owns the preview. Changing it forces replacement.
- `pull_request_id` (Number) The pull request number the preview was created for. Changing it forces replacement.
